campaign.name: Higgsfield 20VC Clipping
campaign.rate: $1 per 1K views, min payout $1, max $350 per clip
campaign.rules: Footage only from the WeTransfer link. Higgsfield watermark big on the whole clip. English captions. Own hook in the first seconds. 30 to 60 s. Never change or splice Alex's words. 40%+ views from US, UK, CA, AU. Likes visible, 0.20% engagement, keep 30 days. Submit link on Whop, then demographics and a ticket when the clip hits min payout.

clips.hook: Europe is extremely competitive in AI
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO Alex Mashrabov on why Europe is extremely competitive in AI
clips.caption: Alex points to Legora, ElevenLabs, Lovable and ASML: outside the model layer, he says Europe is extremely competitive. Energy is the open question.

clips.hook: Silicon Valley: people jump jobs every 2 years
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO: Silicon Valley job-hopping vs European loyalty when building teams
clips.caption: Alex sees people in Silicon Valley switch jobs every two years. For building a strong team, he thinks loyalty is where Europe can compete.

clips.hook: My mother had to work three jobs
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO Alex Mashrabov on his mother's three jobs and his father's sacrifice
clips.caption: Alex on growing up: his mother worked three jobs and his father dedicated his life to him. He says capital and exits can't fully change things.
clips.end: Who sacrificed the most for you?

clips.hook: I made $1M+ and bought family homes. I own none.
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO made over $1M, bought apartments for his family, and owns no property
clips.caption: After selling his first company, Alex spent the money on apartments for his parents and relatives. He owns no property himself and drives a Tesla Model 3.

lower.title: Alex Mashrabov, Higgsfield CEO
lower.sub: Sold AI Factory to Snap for $166M

clips.end: Would you have done the same?

clips.hook: One work-free day with my son in 3 months
clips.title: Higgsfield CEO on 80 to 90 hour weeks and finding one full day with his son
clips.caption: Alex works 80 to 90 hours a week on Higgsfield. In three months he found one full day with his son, with no emails and no talking to the team.
